data.notes: It challenges Sam's 'lost on price' story correctly: Martin saw only rate lines and nothing in Fernbrook's numbers. Every area points the right way, and the actions are short, plain messaging moves tied to A1. It misses the total-cost answer to the incumbent (gateway fee, chargeback work), which is one of the must-catch items. 'Drop average uplift' appears in both the trigger and message findings, and the competitor why says Lucy told Sam about the shift to rate when Sam observed it himself.
